boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Gettysburg College
boards.description: Ten currently documented evening food stops around Gettysburg, ranging from nearby pizza counters to drive-thrus and a 24-hour convenience kitchen. Confirm hours before leaving campus, especially on holidays or academic breaks.

cards.title: Wendy's Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: An all-week late-night drive-thru on York Road
cards.notes: Check mobile ordering before leaving campus, then use the York Road drive-thru for food service documented through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: The latest verified nightly restaurant hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. every day at 1268 York Road.
cards.source_title: Wendy's York Rd in Gettysburg, PA
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. seven days a week; verify holiday hours before traveling.

cards.title: Midnight on York Road
cards.subtitle: Drive-thru service after the dining room closes
cards.notes: Order ahead and plan on drive-thru access after 10 p.m.; the official schedule keeps that service running until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A midnight option with a clearly documented access change.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists daily drive-thru hours until midnight at 1350 York Road and identifies the location as open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Gettysburg, PA — 1350 York Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service is listed until midnight daily; the published dine-in schedule closes earlier, so do not assume indoor seating late at night.

cards.title: Pizza Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: Carryout or delivery from 500 York Street
cards.notes: Check the live store status, choose delivery or carryout, and place the order early enough to clear the midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A late pizza order with both campus-bound delivery and carryout paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Gettysburg location page identifies the store at 500 York Street and displays service until midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 500 York St in Gettysburg
cards.access_notes: The official location page displays closing at midnight; because hours vary by day, confirm the live status before ordering.

cards.title: The Natural Springs Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Late carryout and delivery beside the Gettysburg Marketplace
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to choose delivery or carryout; Friday and Saturday extend one hour later than weeknights.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-midnight pizza counter east of central Gettysburg.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns' official page lists delivery and carryout until midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday at 44 Natural Springs Road.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza Natural Springs Road
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout run until midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday, according to the official location page.

cards.title: The 24-Hour York Road Stop
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock convenience food east of town
cards.notes: Treat this as a vehicle-oriented run, confirm kitchen-item availability in the app, and use the 24-hour store for flexible timing.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Farms announced that its Gettysburg store at 1580 York Road operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for convenience, food, and fuel needs.
cards.source_title: Royal Farms Opening Store in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
cards.access_notes: The company's Gettysburg opening announcement states that the location operates 24 hours and 365 days a year; individual kitchen items may vary.

cards.title: Steinwehr Avenue Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: An 11 p.m. drive-thru south of downtown
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service after the lobby closes at 10 p.m.; mobile ordering is listed among this location's available services.
cards.short_summary: A later drive-thru window on the battlefield side of town.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page lists the 517 Steinwehr Avenue drive-thru until 11 p.m. daily, with restaurant and lobby hours until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 517 Steinwehr Ave, Gettysburg, PA
cards.access_notes: The drive-thru is listed until 11 p.m. daily, while restaurant and lobby service ends at 10 p.m.; use the correct access mode.

cards.title: The Late DQ Treat Run
cards.subtitle: Frozen treats until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday if you want the latest window; the official schedule closes one hour earlier on other nights.
cards.short_summary: A weekend dessert counter with a clearly documented late window.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen's official page lists the Treat Only store at 915 York Road until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Dairy Queen Store — 915 York Rd, Gettysburg
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours extend to 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday on the official location page.

cards.title: Tommy's Weekend Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: Steinwehr Avenue pizza until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Use this for a Friday or Saturday pizza run, and check the posted schedule first because Tuesday is the restaurant's closed day.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Gettysburg pizza counter with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tommy's Pizza's official website lists its 105 Steinwehr Avenue restaurant until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 9 p.m. on other open days.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday service is listed until 10 p.m.; Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Sunday end at 9 p.m., and Tuesday is closed.

cards.title: Wood-Fired Pizza on York Street
cards.subtitle: A downtown kitchen open later on weekends
cards.notes: Go for the food-service window, not the later bar schedule; the kitchen remains open until 10 p.m. only on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A central-square-adjacent pizza kitchen with a distinct weekend cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: The Upper Crust's official site lists kitchen hours until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday at 19 York Street.
cards.source_title: Upper Crust Gift Cards — Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Food service ends at 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; the separately listed midnight time applies to the bar.

cards.title: The Baltimore Pike Dinner Run
cards.subtitle: Mediterranean food with 11 p.m. weekend hours
cards.notes: Make this a planned car trip five miles south of center square, and call ahead if arriving near the Friday or Saturday cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A longer off-campus dinner run with the board's latest full-service weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Olivia's official website lists hours until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday, 10 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday, and 9 p.m. Sunday at 3015 Baltimore Pike.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists 11 p.m. closing Friday–Saturday, 10 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday, 9 p.m. Sunday, and Monday closure.

warnings: Hours can change for holidays, weather, seasonal operations, or academic breaks; verify the linked official page immediately before departure.
Several York Road and Baltimore Pike destinations are vehicle-oriented and are not represented as safe or practical walking trips from campus.
